summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, disclosing ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. The filing details multiple open-market buyback transactions from March 20 through April 15, 2026, with prices ranging from ~USD 6.57 to 7.14 per share. Each repurchase represents less than 0.08% of issued shares, executed daily in small lots. The board has authorized these purchases as part of a capital return program. No advisor is named. The repurchased shares are not yet cancelled. Watch for continued buyback pace and eventual cancellation, which reduces share count and supports earnings per share.
